1difa64:303: Hermes is an autonomous AI Agent runtime framework built by Nous Research. It is not a single-turn Q&A model wrapper, but an Agent Runtime that can continuously run, call tools, accumulate experience, and grow with usage. When an AI Agent truly starts solving problems—whether it completes them correctly or goes off course—the truly hard problem is often not whether the result is right, but what it actually did. A single run of Hermes is not an ordinary model call. Behind a seemingly simple interaction there may be multiple rounds of reasoning, tool calls, result injection, context expansion, and new reasoning loops. If the system can only provide the final reply, a few scattered logs, or a usage summary for one call, then Hermes is still a black box.
